title: Get parameter rule for MEMBER search results "&parentid=123"

## Get parameter rule for MEMBER search results "&parentid=123"
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000070467
Member search results can be filtered by adding the parentid parameter to the search results URL.
This returns sub-account members assigned to the specified parent member ID.

## URL Format
Use the following URL structure:
Replace 123 with the parent member's User ID.
